vo: That was Wardrobe in twenty-four seconds. Now let's slow down, and walk through every feature: from the first photo to next week's plan.
It starts with the plus button. Add clothes opens with a short guide to a good photo: lay the piece flat, in daylight, on a plain surface.
Take a photo, or pick several at once. Smart AI cuts the background away. It runs right on your phone, so your photos never leave it.
If the cut needs a touch-up, the eraser and restore brushes fix it, and you can pinch to zoom for the fine detail.
Then add the details. Wardrobe picks out the colour for you. Choose the category and type, add a brand, a size and a price, and tag the occasions and seasons it suits.
It even asks for the real length, so every piece stays to scale when you try outfits on. Tap Save to wardrobe, and it's in.
Everything you own lives here, sorted into tops, bottoms, shoes, jackets and accessories, with today's outfit waiting at the top.
Search by name, brand or colour, or jump straight to a category.
Tap any piece to see its details: how often you've worn it, and what it costs per wear. Mark it as worn today, send it to the laundry, or archive what you no longer wear.
Try on is where outfits come together. Tops, bottoms and shoes sit in rows, at their real size. Swipe each row to mix and match.
Lock a piece you love, and shuffle everything around it. Bring in jackets and accessories for another layer.
Stuck? Tap Style me. It picks a combination whose colours work together, suited to the season, and even the weather. Not for you? Tap the thumbs-down, and it steers away from that pairing.
Like what you see? Tap Create outfit. On the board, move and resize every piece, change the background, and undo any step.
Saved outfits collect in Outfits. Favourite them, tag them, duplicate one to make a variation, or share it as an image.
Plan puts outfits on your calendar. Pick an outfit for any day in the agenda, or switch to the month view.
Add your city, and each day shows its forecast. On an empty day, tap Style me, and Wardrobe plans one for you.
When the day comes, tap Mark as worn. Every wear is logged.
Lists keep sets of clothes together. A capsule is a small set that all works together, and Wardrobe counts how many combinations it makes.
A trip is a packing list with dates and a forecast. Tick items off as you pack, then share the list.
And the wish list notes what you want to buy next, with its price, so you shop with a plan.
Insights turns your logged wears into numbers: your items, your outfits, your wardrobe's value, and your colours.
It shows what you wear most, the best cost per wear, what's still waiting for a first wear, and what you might consider letting go.
Make it yours in Settings: light or dark mode, five accent colours, and your own currency.
Everything is stored on your device. Back it up to a single file, and restore it on any phone.
And the whole app is one HTML file. No app store, no account. Open it, and your wardrobe is ready.
